topic: Vitamin and supplement myths vs facts
headline: Supplements
intro: Vitamins and natural products are popular in winter. Here's what's true, and when to ask us.

points.title: Myth: Natural = safe
points.body: Fact: Natural health products can still cause side effects. Ask us before adding a new one.
points.tip: Natural still means read the label.

points.title: Myth: More is better
points.body: Fact: Taking more than the label says isn't better, and some vitamins can build up in the body.

points.title: Myth: They won't mix
points.body: Fact: Some supplements can interact with prescriptions. Tell us all you take.
points.tip: Keep one list of all you take.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.

3 supplement myths you still believe 💊

Vitamins and natural health products near you in North York: here's what's true. Myth 1: natural means safe. Fact: natural products can still cause side effects. Myth 2: more is better. Fact: follow the label, some vitamins build up in the body. Myth 3: supplements won't mix with my meds. Fact: some can interact with prescriptions, so tell your pharmacist everything you take.
